facts.fact: The Council of Ministers on 16 April 2026 authorised procurement for the digital ministry's 2026 specific projects (Elites IT programme, Zama Tche citizen houses, datacenters, RESINA network, institutional capacity) at a total cost of 9,113,100,000 F CFA excluding tax, financed by the 2026 state budget.
